card.name: Old Testament narrative and Bible references
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside retellings of Old Testament stories about Moses, David, Saul or Elijah. This includes small linking words and verse-number digits.

modes.label: Linking words in Bible retelling
modes.description: Small words such as in, by, of or the right after a biblical figure or place in a narrative.
modes.example: set up by Moses<< in>> the Wilderness

modes.label: Verse references and dates
modes.description: Digits or spaces inside scripture citations or ancient dates.
